tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use Rustls as the TLS implementation. It was chosen because it is a pure Rust library, which avoids the complexity of C bindings in a security-critical component, reduces the attack surface from C interop layers, and keeps memory-safety guarantees across the cryptographic stack. No later decision has changed this choice.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md
